description: Authentic Clinical Phonocardiogram Dataset from PhysioNet / Computing in Cardiology (CinC) Challenge 2016
source: PhysioNet (MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology & CinC 2016)
license: Open Access - Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
clinical_provenance: Recorded from hospitalized cardiac patients and healthy volunteers using electronic stethoscopes at standard auscultation locations (Aortic, Mitral, Pulmonic, Tricuspid areas).

samples.verified_diagnosis: Normal cardiac acoustics; clear S1 closure followed by physiological S2.

samples.patient_cohort: PhysioNet CinC 2016 Valvular Disease Inpatient Cohort
samples.auscultation_site: 2nd Right Intercostal Space radiating to carotids
samples.verified_diagnosis: Aortic valve area < 1.0 cm2, peak transvalvular velocity > 4.0 m/s.

samples.patient_cohort: PhysioNet CinC 2016 Valvular Disease Inpatient Cohort
samples.verified_diagnosis: Effective Regurgitant Orifice Area (EROA) >= 0.40 cm2, regurgitant volume >= 60 mL.

samples.patient_cohort: PhysioNet CinC 2016 Valvular Disease Inpatient Cohort
samples.timing: Early Diastolic Decrescendo Murmur immediately following S2
samples.verified_diagnosis: Regurgitant fraction > 50%, holodiastolic flow reversal in descending thoracic aorta.
